Title: User Experience Researcher
Description: Location: Remote Schedule: Monday to Friday 07:00-16:00 English Level: Advanced / Fluent Position: User Experience Researcher User Experience Researcher (Mexico) The User Experience Researcher role is primarily tasked with supporting our US-based clients and working with a large project team in delivering impactful solutions for our clients. By studying user behaviors and current manual workflows, you will provide the insights necessary to design improved processes that leverage Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to automate as much as possible. What you’ll do: ● Define comprehensive research goals and select appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods to investigate complex business processes. ● Lead the recruitment of participants and conduct user interviews, contextual inquiries, and usability testing to understand current manual document processing workflows. ● Analyze user behavior to identify pain points, motivations, and opportunities for efficiency gains through the implementation of document processing and OCR technology. ● Collaborate closely with the UX Designer and technical leads to translate research findings into actionable insights, creating personas, user journey maps, and future-state service blueprints. ● Research and benchmark industry best practices regarding automated document processing and OCR to ensure client solutions are best-in-class. ● Present findings and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and the engineering team to influence the design of automated workflows. ● Conduct validation testing on proposed automated solutions to ensure they meet user needs and deliver quantifiable efficiency improvements. ● Develop and maintain research documentation and contribute to the overall project reporting structure. ● Support in the development of executive level presentations / deliverables in Google Slides that adhere to Metafora brand standards. ● Adapt to remote collaboration tools and communication methods to align with the US-based team. How you’ll do it: ● Own It: This is our company, and its success is our success. Every day we act as owners, leaders, and role models to grow the organization collectively and our capabilities individually. ● Relationships First: Authentic human connections are make-or-break in this industry. The heart of our success as a firm is built on the relationships with one another and our clients. ● Excellence Always: Mediocrity is not an option. We set high standards for ourselves, and the people with whom we work. We expect excellence and guarantee satisfaction with our work. ● Think Big: We challenge ourselves to stretch and shape each other’s thinking to deliver lasting change and true value. ● Learn & Teach: Building and sharing knowledge is our superpower. We develop ourselves, learn from others, and generously share what we know. What we need: ● Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Anthropology, Design, or a related field. ● 3-7 years of professional experience in User Experience Research, preferably within a consulting, enterprise software, or logistics environment. ● Proficiency in visual collaboration and design tools such as Miro, Visio, and Figma to map workflows and present insights. ● Expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) or Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs) for data analysis and presentation. ● Basic working knowledge of SQL or the ability to learn to perform data analysis. ● Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
